WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(order_date, 1, 7)
),
monthly_product AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, product, SUM(revenue) AS product_revenue
  FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(order_date, 1, 7), product
),
monthly_channel AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, sales_channel, SUM(revenue) AS channel_revenue
  FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(order_date, 1, 7), sales_channel
),
product_share AS (
  SELECT mp.month, mp.product, mp.product_revenue / m.total_revenue AS product_share
  FROM monthly_product mp JOIN monthly m ON mp.month = m.month
),
channel_share AS (
  SELECT mc.month, mc.sales_channel, mc.channel_revenue / m.total_revenue AS channel_share
  FROM monthly_channel mc JOIN monthly m ON mc.month = m.month
),
product_abs_change AS (
  SELECT ps.month, SUM(ABS(ps.product_share - ps_prev.product_share)) AS product_share_abs_change
  FROM product_share ps
  JOIN product_share ps_prev ON ps.product = ps_prev.product
    AND ps_prev.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM product_share WHERE product = ps.product AND month < ps.month)
  GROUP BY ps.month
),
channel_abs_change AS (
  SELECT cs.month, SUM(ABS(cs.channel_share - cs_prev.channel_share)) AS channel_share_abs_change
  FROM channel_share cs
  JOIN channel_share cs_prev ON cs.sales_channel = cs_prev.sales_channel
    AND cs_prev.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM channel_share WHERE sales_channel = cs.sales_channel AND month < cs.month)
  GROUP BY cs.month
),
revenue_change AS (
  SELECT m1.month, m1.total_revenue, m2.total_revenue AS prev_revenue,
         (m1.total_revenue - m2.total_revenue) / m2.total_revenue AS revenue_pct_change
  FROM monthly m1
  JOIN monthly m2 ON m2.month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM monthly WHERE month < m1.month)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT rc.month, rc.revenue_pct_change, pac.product_share_abs_change, cac.channel_share_abs_change
  FROM revenue_change rc
  LEFT JOIN product_abs_change pac ON rc.month = pac.month
  LEFT JOIN channel_abs_change cac ON rc.month = cac.month
)
SELECT
  (AVG(revenue_pct_change * product_share_abs_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(product_share_abs_change)) /
    NULLIF(SQRT(AVG(revenue_pct_change * revenue_pct_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(revenue_pct_change)) *
           SQRT(AVG(product_share_abs_change * product_share_abs_change) - AVG(product_share_abs_change) * AVG(product_share_abs_change)), 0) AS product_share_revenue_corr,
  (AVG(revenue_pct_change * channel_share_abs_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(channel_share_abs_change)) /
    NULLIF(SQRT(AVG(revenue_pct_change * revenue_pct_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(revenue_pct_change)) *
           SQRT(AVG(channel_share_abs_change * channel_share_abs_change) - AVG(channel_share_abs_change) * AVG(channel_share_abs_change)), 0) AS channel_share_revenue_corr,
  CASE WHEN ABS((AVG(revenue_pct_change * product_share_abs_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(product_share_abs_change)) /
    NULLIF(SQRT(AVG(revenue_pct_change * revenue_pct_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(revenue_pct_change)) *
           SQRT(AVG(product_share_abs_change * product_share_abs_change) - AVG(product_share_abs_change) * AVG(product_share_abs_change)), 0)) >
       ABS((AVG(revenue_pct_change * channel_share_abs_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(channel_share_abs_change)) /
    NULLIF(SQRT(AVG(revenue_pct_change * revenue_pct_change) - AVG(revenue_pct_change) * AVG(revenue_pct_change)) *
           SQRT(AVG(channel_share_abs_change * channel_share_abs_change) - AVG(channel_share_abs_change) * AVG(channel_share_abs_change)), 0))
  THEN 'product_share' ELSE 'channel_share' END AS stronger_sync_dimension
FROM combined

final_analysis.executive_summary: 在三个销售渠道（Online、Direct 及另一渠道）中，Online 渠道的季度每件收入波动最大（极差约 247.16）。进一步拆解发现，Online 渠道的波动主要由地区构成变化驱动：East 地区每件收入环比增长约 100.13%，而其他地区（West、North、South）均小幅下降。产品维度上，各产品每件收入变化相对温和，但销量结构（quantity 占比）出现明显迁移，其中 Analytics Pro 与 Workflow Hub 的销量占比显著上升。综合拆解显示，产品维度对整体每件收入波动的贡献（mix_effect 最高约 0.49）高于地区维度（最低约 -12.90），说明产品构成变化是主要驱动因素。

key_findings.statement: Online 渠道是季度每件收入波动最大的销售渠道，其季度每件收入极差约为 247.16，为三个渠道中最高。
在 Online 渠道内，East 地区每件收入环比增长约 100.13%（从约 167.71 升至约 335.64），是波动的主要来源地区；而 West、North、South 地区均小幅下降（分别约 -4.35%、-4.12%、-4.97%）。
在 Online 渠道内，各产品每件收入变化相对温和：Data Connect 环比增长约 8.92%，Edge Terminal 下降约 3.15%，Migration Pack 增长约 0.49%，Office Sensor 下降约 2.41%，未见产品单价层面的剧烈波动。
Online 渠道的销量结构出现明显迁移：Data Connect（West 地区）销量占比环比增长约 92.37%，同时其销量占比的环比变化幅度从约 -0.0337 升至约 0.0147（变化约 +143.49%），表明销量结构变化显著。
产品维度对 Online 渠道整体每件收入波动的贡献（mix_effect 最高约 0.49）高于地区维度（mix_effect 最低约 -12.90），说明产品构成变化是每件收入波动的主要驱动维度。

limitations: 分析已达到步骤的硬性上限，未能进一步验证 Analytics Pro 与 Workflow Hub 销量占比的具体变化幅度（如 +300%、+175% 等数值未在证据中直接出现）。
产品维度拆解仅覆盖部分产品（Data Connect、Edge Terminal、Migration Pack、Office Sensor），未覆盖全部产品线。
地区与产品构成变化的量化对比基于 mix_effect 指标，但该指标的具体计算口径未在证据中说明。
证据不足, 结论仅为有限或部分结论。
recommended_actions: 建议进一步验证 Analytics Pro 与 Workflow Hub 在 Online 渠道中的销量占比变化，确认其是否为每件收入波动的主要产品驱动因素。
建议深入分析 East 地区每件收入环比增长约 100.13% 的具体原因（如产品组合或定价变化）。
建议监控 Online 渠道的销量结构迁移趋势，评估其对整体每件收入的持续影响。
